tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Off-white paper on light, ink on dark. Never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, FAQ rows, the notification strip, table header rows. 4% ink into off-white (light) / 4% off-white into ink (dark).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inline code background and the copy-command field. Text on it: ink or ink-muted only.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: section dividers, card outlines, table rules. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries (inputs, secondary buttons) and diagram connectors. Holds 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text, headings, icons. 15.5:1 on surface, 13.2:1 or better on surface-raised and surface-sunken, both themes. Not the brand colour Ink — that is brand-ink.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, captions, number conditions, eyebrows, status icons. 5.3:1 or better on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken, both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Text links and the 'not yet' status label. Crimson on light (5.7:1 on surface, 5.1:1 on surface-sunken); ember on dark (5.5:1 on surface, 4.7:1 on surface-sunken) because crimson on ink fails at 2.7:1.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered and pressed links. 6.4:1 or better on every surface, both themes.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill — one per viewport. Text on it is on-action.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover and press.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action and action-hover. Off-white on crimson 5.7:1 (light); ink on ember 5.5:1 (dark). Never white on ember.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 5.5:1 or better on surface in both themes. Inside the terminal (always dark) the ring switches to ember (5.5:1 on term-bg).

tokens.name: crimson
tokens.usage: Brand primary, unchanged in both themes. The logo's colour and the source of action/accent on light. Do not set text in crimson on dark surfaces (2.7:1).

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Brand secondary, unchanged in both themes. Non-text marks only on light (2.8:1 on off-white): the gradient bar, the active-stage glow, diagram second series. Text-safe on ink.

tokens.name: ember-glow
tokens.usage: Translucent ember fill behind the one active element in a diagram (the plan-review stage; the Worker holding the claim). Heat where the work is — one per diagram, always named in the diagram's legend or caption.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Raw brand ink, constant across themes. The wordmark colour; terminal-light background.

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: Raw brand off-white, constant across themes. OG image ground; text on the terminal.

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: Terminal block background. The terminal is dark in both themes; on dark it sits one step below the page.

tokens.name: term-ink
tokens.usage: Terminal output text and commands. 15.5:1 or better on term-bg.

tokens.name: term-muted
tokens.usage: Terminal prompt '$', comments, the title-bar label. 6.4:1 or better on term-bg.

tokens.name: term-accent
tokens.usage: Terminal refusal lines ('claim failed: path contention'). 5.5:1 or better on term-bg. Paired with the words themselves, never colour alone.

tokens.name: term-border
tokens.usage: Hairline under the terminal title bar. Decorative.

tokens.name: term-control
tokens.usage: Outline of the terminal's Copy button. 3.6:1 on term-bg (light), 3.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: status-works
tokens.usage: Icon for 'Works' rows. Alias of text — shipped needs no colour; the check icon and the column heading carry it.

tokens.name: status-gap
tokens.usage: The LABEL word on 'Not proven', 'Not built' and 'Caveat' rows (the icon stays text-muted). Always a word, never colour alone. One accent per viewport: this is it on the What works page.

tokens.name: status-design
tokens.usage: The label word and icon on 'By design' rows — a decision, not a gap, so it carries no accent.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: rt-display
styles.sample: Your agents can't skip the review step.
styles.usage: Home hero H1 only, at 1024px and up (rt-title-hero). One per page.

styles.name: rt-display-sm
styles.sample: Your agents can't skip the review step.
styles.usage: Home hero H1 below 1024px; H1 of secondary pages and posts at 1024px and up (rt-title).

styles.name: rt-h2-sm
styles.usage: Section headings inside a blog post (prose h2).

styles.name: rt-h2
styles.usage: Section headings (one per section); secondary-page and post H1 below 1024px (rt-title).

styles.name: rt-h3
styles.usage: Feature card titles, How-it-works steps, FAQ questions, post titles in lists.

styles.name: rt-lead
styles.sample: rite runs a fleet of AI coding agents against one codebase.
styles.usage: Hero subhead and the first paragraph of a page or post. Max 56ch. Drops to 18/28 below 768px.

styles.name: rt-body
styles.sample: The second Worker to claim the same path is refused.
styles.usage: All running text, including blog prose. Max measure (64ch).

styles.name: rt-body-sm
styles.sample: Measured in a four-minute soak of six concurrent Workers.
styles.usage: Card body copy, number conditions, table cells, footer links.

styles.name: rt-meta
styles.usage: Post dates, bylines, captions under diagrams. text-muted.

styles.name: rt-code
styles.usage: Terminal blocks, code blocks, the install command. Steps down to 14px below 768px.

styles.name: rt-code-inline
styles.usage: Command and path names inside running text, on surface-sunken (on surface inside cards).

styles.name: rt-eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrows above an H2, uppercase, text-muted. Only where it adds information the H2 doesn't.

styles.name: rt-figure
styles.usage: The number in a proof point. Always followed by its conditions in rt-body-sm.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls; label to input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding pair (12/20); list item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; paragraph spacing; card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter; heading to body in a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding, and page-header top padding, at 1024px and up.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Home hero top padding at 1024px and up (rt-page-head-hero).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, tags, the version chip.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards, terminal blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels only (the notification strip). Rare.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots in the stage chain. Never on buttons.

layout.note: Page-level measures. Single column, quiet, generous.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max width of the page container (nav, sections, footer).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text and blog prose — about 70–75 characters of Plex Sans at 17px. Leads cap at 56ch.

tokens.name: narrow
tokens.usage: Max width of the FAQ list and the notification strip (rt-narrow).

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Sticky nav bar height; also scroll-margin-top for anchored headings.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and rule.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring width and offset.
